dialogues.speaker: Tubby
dialogues.text: I do, in fact, have an adeptus name, it's just awfully difficult to remember... What was it again... Ah yes, "Rain Calmer."

dialogues.speaker: Tubby
dialogues.text: There was once a time of unending battle, when the land was swept by great storms, and neither the sun nor moon would shine.

dialogues.speaker: Tubby
dialogues.text: Ping and our old friends longed for days of sunshine, and thus, they gave me this name.

dialogues.speaker: Tubby
dialogues.text: That is why I always take on the color of the blue sky, no matter what form I take when presenting myself to others.
